verdict.rationale: The npx skills install path copies skills into the repo as ordinary editable files, and the docs say nothing updates behind your back: changes arrive only when you run `npx skills update`. A hands-on probe confirms the copy install works. However, the plugin routes (Claude, Codex) update themselves by default or at startup, and no explicit version pinning or lockfile is documented. missing for 10: explicit version pinning or lockfile mechanism, a documented way to pin or disable auto-update on the plugin install routes, independent corroboration of update control.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates

citations.quote: It writes the skills into your repo as ordinary files you own and can edit. Nothing updates behind your back
Nothing updates behind your back; pull my latest changes when you want them with `npx skills update`.
